title: Jalacraft Official
description: This pack consists of a very minimal modset designed to improve upon the multiplayer experience without subtracting from or bypassing vanilla gameplay.
body:
Have you been scrolling through modpacks trying to find something that improves your multiplayer experience without adding countless over the top "vanilla+" mods? Well look no further because i believe i have what you may be seeking.

The current version (1.21.11) adds the ability to make Shapeless portals, Play custom music discs, improvements to armor stands, Custom Enderdragon Boss fight, And Improved Multiplayer features like Simple Voice chat and Claims
